title: Safe Offline SARS eFiling Simulation: IRP5 Source Codes & ITR12 Basics
simulationNotice: OFFLINE TRAINING SIMULATION ONLY. Uses a fictional IRP5 certificate and never connects to SARS.

fields.label: Tax Assessment Year
fields.hint: Enter the assessment year shown on the sample IRP5 (2026).

fields.label: IRP5 Code 3601 — Gross Salary Income (ZAR)
fields.hint: Copy the gross salary amount for Code 3601 from the sample IRP5 (R180 000).

fields.label: IRP5 Code 4102 — PAYE Tax Deducted (ZAR)
fields.hint: Copy the PAYE tax already deducted under Code 4102 (R14 500).

fields.label: IRP5 Code 4005 — Medical Scheme Contributions (ZAR)
fields.hint: Copy the medical scheme contributions under Code 4005 (R18 000).

fields.label: Declaration & Simulation Acknowledgement
fields.hint: Tick the declaration to confirm the figures match the sample IRP5.
